title: Smooth split-lattice torus projections and reduced products
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and $L$ an abelian group with a finite integral basis $b_1,\ldots,b_r$, $r\geq0$. Let $A=k[L]=\bigoplus_{l\in L}ke^l$, with $e^le^{l'}=e^{l+l'}$, let $T=\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $Y$ be any $k$-scheme. The projection $\pi:T\times_kY\to Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and has a section induced by $A\to k$, $e^l\mapsto1$; in particular it is surjective on underlying points. Thus $T$ is smooth over $k$.

For each extension field $K/k$ the canonical $K$-algebra map $A\otimes_kK\simeq K[L]$, $e^l\otimes c\mapsto ce^l$, is an isomorphism and $K[L]$ is an integral domain. For every reduced commutative $k$-algebra $R$, the ring $R\otimes_k A$ is reduced (its only nilpotent element is zero). Consequently if $Y$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme], then $T\times_kY$ is reduced. These assertions allow arbitrary characteristic, reducible or empty $Y$, the zero ring $R$, and rank zero.

proof.text: Transport UniqueSums along the injective integral basis representation L -> (Fin r ->₀ Z), then apply Mathlib AddMonoidAlgebra IsDomain. Mathlib AddMonoidAlgebra.scalarTensorEquiv, composed with the K-linear tensor symmetry commRight, constructs A tensor K equiv K[L] with the required monomial formula. These are explicit proved constructions, with no choice from an unproved existence statement.

Apply the proved source-library theorem isReduced_tensorProduct_of_forall_residueField (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.Nilpotent.GeometricallyReduced). Every residue-field tensor of R with A is the group algebra of L over that residue field by scalarTensorEquiv, hence is reduced by the domain argument. Thus R tensor A is reduced for every reduced R, including the zero ring. The source theorem proves the joint residue-field detection using basis coordinates; no finite generation or perfectness is assumed.

Pull the affine cover of reduced Y back along the projection. For each affine component Spec R, use Spec.map_surjective to write its structure map as Spec of a ring map k -> R, then use pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso and pullbackSpecIso to identify the pulled-back component with Spec(A tensor R). Tensor symmetry and the preceding step make this ring reduced; affine_isReduced_iff and IsReduced.of_openCover prove reducedness of the product. Apply this also when Y is the spectrum of any extension field to obtain GeometricallyReduced for T -> Spec k.

Module.Finite.of_basis makes L a finite Z-module, hence a finitely generated additive group. Mathlib AddMonoidAlgebra.finiteType_iff_group_fg gives finite type for A. Its canonical Hopf-algebra structure supplies the group scheme on Spec A. The Mathlib theorem AlgebraicGeometry.smooth_of_grpObj now proves smoothness of T over k from its finite type and geometric reducedness. Smoothness is stable under base change, proving the asserted projection smooth. This shorter argument replaces the square-zero lifting calculation below the unit level.

The specified augmentation is an algebra homomorphism, so its composite with the scalar inclusion is the identity. Contravariance of Spec gives epsilon composed with T -> Spec k equal to the identity. Pair y composed with epsilon and the identity of Y by pullback.lift. The projection identities give both required section equations; evaluating the second projection identity at any point of Y proves surjectivity. Rank zero and empty Y require no case split. Combine these statements with the domain, scalar-extension and reducedness results above.

lean.statement: theorem split_lattice_torus_projection (k : Type u) [Field k] (L : Type u) [AddCommGroup L] (r : ℕ) (_b : Module.Basis (Fin r) ℤ L) (Y : Scheme.{u}) (y : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) : Smooth (pullback.snd (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (AddMonoidAlgebra k L)))) y) ∧ (∃ s : Y ⟶ pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (AddMonoidAlgebra k L)))) y, s ≫ pullback.snd (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (AddMonoidAlgebra k L)))) y = 𝟙 Y ∧ s ≫ pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (AddMonoidAlgebra k L)))) y = y ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AddMonoidAlgebra.lift k k L 1).toRingHom)) ∧ Surjective (pullback.snd (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (AddMonoidAlgebra k L)))) y) ∧ Smooth (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (AddMonoidAlgebra k L)))) ∧ (∀ (K : Type (max u v)) [Field K] [Algebra k K], (∃ e : @AlgEquiv K (AddMonoidAlgebra k L ⊗[k] K) (AddMonoidAlgebra K L) _ _ _ (Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := k)) _, ∀ (l : L) (c : K), e (AddMonoidAlgebra.single l (1 : k) ⊗ₜ[k] c) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single l c) ∧ IsDomain (AddMonoidAlgebra K L)) ∧ (∀ (R : Type (max u w)) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [_root_.IsReduced R], _root_.IsReduced (R ⊗[k] AddMonoidAlgebra k L)) ∧ (IsReduced Y → IsReduced (pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (AddMonoidAlgebra k L)))) y))
